patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with large, bold typography on the left and dynamic product imagery on the right, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
Hero and main headings use an extremely large, condensed, and bold display sans-serif font, creating an impactful and distinctive brand voice.
High-contrast color palette featuring deep indigo backgrounds paired with vibrant orange accents for CTAs and key information, creating an energetic feel.
A mandatory age verification modal is presented as a fixed overlay immediately upon page load, obscuring the entire page content until user interaction.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect on background elements as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth behind the foreground text and product imagery.
A horizontal feature bar with key product benefits sticks to the bottom of the viewport for a duration as the user scrolls, then disappears as the footer comes into view.
Product information is presented through a mix of card grids for product types and mocktails, and a three-column image grid demonstrating usage steps.

technique_notes: A full-page age gate modal is triggered on initial page load, rendered as a fixed overlay with a light background and bold, centered text. It requires user interaction before the main site content becomes accessible.
The hero section utilizes WebGL or CSS transforms to create a subtle parallax scrolling effect, where background elements move at a slower rate than foreground content, enhancing visual depth.
A sticky element at the bottom of the viewport displays key product features, maintaining visibility during a portion of the scroll before eventually scrolling out of view.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed display headings (~6x body) for hero and main section titles, contrasted with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards and buttons, with some elements like input fields featuring a pill-shaped radius.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy spacing between major sections, creating distinct content blocks, while internal card layouts maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an extremely bold, condensed display typeface for hero and main headings, combined with a high-contrast, vibrant color palette, creates an energetic and memorable brand presence. The prominent, fixed age gate modal also sets an immediate, no-nonsense tone.
